# HexPiece 4.0.2

Your list on the Itsumade, the human's half (as you asked, the form waits for your new jointed model). **Not tested in game yet:** the
build and every test suite pass; every look below was rendered off-game with the game's own drawing code and checked.

## The lightning
- **Every Itsumade bolt is now the Conqueror release's very bolt**: the same thick 3D tubes, the same sharp angular runs, branches,
  needle tips and glow (the Bow, Enormous Presence, Thy Death). The thin strokes they used before are gone from the fruit.

## Enormous Presence (C)
- Its bolts strike **now and then at random** (two to four seconds apart), not non-stop; the body crackles with the mod's own
  Conqueror's Haki arcs, at random too.
- **No purple ring** on the ground any more.

## Yokai Blast (V)
- **The beam leaves your hand**, not your belly (the pose's fist was never found in third person: it is now).
- **Once you let go you can neither move nor look around** until the beam ends.
- **Its fire is its own, after your Yokai Beam reference, not Kaido's**: a blinding white-hot ball in the hand with an orange halo
  ring and rays, lens streaks across it; the beam a white-hot core in orange fire, thin laser lines turning round it, black flames
  twisting round it as two dark ribbons.
- The same fire, the same lock (no moving, no looking around) and **a big ball of fire at its end** for the form's Yokai Beam: a
  blinding sun in rolling orange fire that cools and rises away as smoke (Kaido's bomb and its residue explosions are gone from it).

## Thy Death (B)
- **The storm stands over the spot you aim at** (up to 96 blocks away) and stays there; it no longer follows you.
- **The clouds are clouds**: soft dark billows, lit grey-violet on top and near black underneath, no hard edges.
- The bolts are the release's (above); each bursts in a ball of your Haki's light where it lands, **no ring on the ground**.

## Gorosei Stare (X)
- No rings round the target any more (the dust and the throw stay).

## Hellish Teleport (N)
- **You see the trip**: when the circle has formed, everything on it is wrapped in black flames and carried up the middle of a pillar
  of black flames into the sky (2.5 s), then the beam falls from the sky onto the other circle and you come down it (2.5 s), landing
  softly. The pillar is hollow (black flames spiralling round it), so you see yourself inside it.

## The panel
- **Only the moves of the form you are in** show (as a human, the human's; in its form, the form's).

## Gear 5
- **No rings on the ground** round the player any more (Dawn's hole and its pop, Goof Ball's burst).
